prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / ads-marketing. Create a polished original website hero illustration for a Japanese camper repair workshop. Input image 1 is a COMPOSITION reference only: two prominent vehicles in the foreground, a larger main professional behind them, smaller lifestyle vignettes behind. Input image 2 is STYLE and CHARACTER reference only: detailed warm Japanese manga/editorial illustration with precise ink lines, gentle cel shading, an approachable Japanese male mechanic with wavy black hair and charcoal coveralls. Do not copy photographic people or manufacturer branding from image 1.
Composition: one cohesive approximately square 5:4 landscape illustration, all subjects fully inside frame with generous clear edges. Foreground: TWO distinct genuine camping vehicles side by side, large and clearly recognizable, front three-quarter views; left a cream cab-over motorhome with raised sleeping cabin above cab, right an olive-green high-roof camper van with a side awning and camper windows. Both vehicles fully visible, complete wheels, accurate plausible geometry, no car cropped. No ordinary kei delivery trucks. Center upper-middle: the adult mechanic, visible waist-up rising behind the two vehicles as an intentional advertising collage, holding a small wrench naturally at waist height, looking slightly toward a camper rather than directly at viewer. Main mechanic charcoal workwear, not courier uniform, not holding a delivery box.
Rear layer: attractive forest campsite vignettes with a warm tan tent, folding chairs and wooden picnic table, green pine trees and distant mountains; two small school-age children in casual outdoor clothes playing together near the tent, with an adult guardian nearby setting up camp. Children and campsite must be clearly recognizable and visible above/around the vehicles, no faces hidden behind central mechanic. They are small supporting background figures, not main portraits; nobody except optionally the mechanic faces camera. Convey repair expertise supporting enjoyable family camping, cheerful but calm.
Palette: olive green, cream, warm brown, muted natural greens, charcoal workwear, restrained soft blue sky accents. Match image 2's refined illustration style, not photography, no 3D, no kawaii mascot. Clean off-white warm ivory backdrop around the cutout-like illustrated grouping, with soft natural ground shadows. Balanced layered silhouettes with separation, enough detail to enjoy at mobile size without clutter. No readable text anywhere, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no website UI, no electric chargers or delivery packages. Preserve exact TWO foreground campers; no extra background vehicles.
